title: Phase 2：證明 OEIS A071052 的 a(2n) = a(n) + 2n（規則 150 第 n 列的 0 個數）

A071052-even.proof: Lean (core only) for every n >= 0: a071052_double. Two steps of Rule 150 on a configuration dilated to even cells equal one step then dilation (GF(2) Frobenius), so row 2n = row n dilated; the ON count is unchanged (A071053(2n) = A071053(n), already in A071053's FORMULA) and the window grows by 2n zeros. Numeric check: two algorithms in one script (simulation, GF(2) powers) for n <= 2000 incl. cell-by-cell doubling, against the 67 DATA terms (copied from the live entry 2026-11-22), plus an independent critic script (Lucas parity) for n <= 3000.

novelty.note: The A071052 FORMULA is still marked (conjectured) without proof. It is a one-line consequence of A071053(2n) = A071053(n) (stated in A071053 by Peter J. Taylor 2020; a standard Frobenius fact over GF(2)). Nothing new is claimed; the value is closing the open label in OEIS with a checked proof.
